leadText: This is a list of themes and other songs that have been played with the Pokémon animated series when aired in the Bengali dub.
plainText:
This is a list of themes and other songs that have been played with the Pokémon animated series when aired in the Bengali dub.

==Original songs==
These are original themes made for the Bengali dub, which are not based on any theme from the English or Japanese versions.

===Opening themes===
 

===Ending themes===
 

==Openings==
Currently, seasons Pokémon: Indigo League through Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends and movies have not been dubbed into Bengali. For Pokémon Journeys: The Series, Pokémon Master Journeys: The Series, and Pokémon Ultimate Journeys: The Series released on the Pokémon Asia Official (Bengali) YouTube channel, the English versions of the themes were left undubbed.
